name: cacao improvement round 2

model_selection.rule: If feasible, maximum F1; otherwise maximum precision among nonvacuous candidates. Use only validation reports. Freeze before new external image inference.

sources.cocoa_monilia: existing train/val; old test protected regression
sources.serrano_torres: previously inspected external test now development train/val
sources.mendeley_ykbtpsyfv9_v1: ENTIRE cohort reserved for test; predeclared 400-image sample, no model tuning

external_task: image alert classification, not object detection; photos do not supply boxes
baseline: Original four-class YOLO11n, remapped to canonical classes and calibrated on the same validation policy, class-agnostic NMS
motion: Synthetic training blur and frozen stress tests only; no real drone footage available
